title: What Godly Brotherhood Asks of You When Your Brother Is Falling Apart
caption:
When your brother in Christ is falling apart, don't fix him. Show up.

Sit in the room before you say a word. Ask one real question and listen. Carry something specific ("I'm driving you Thursday"). Then stay after everyone else has gone quiet.

Galatians 6:2: "Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ."

Who haven't you checked on in a while? Text him tonight.
